info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve specific market order execution details for wholesale trading based on a provided parameter. It serves as a vital resource for traders and financial analysts who seek to access time-sensitive market data. Utilizing the parameter provided in the request, users can obtain precise insights into wholesale trade executions, enabling informed decision-making. Typical consumers include traders, market analysts, and financial institutions needing real-time execution information.

get.summary: Retrieve market order execution details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the execution details of a market order identified by the resource ID. It provides vital information related to the order execution, helping traders analyze their trades effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the market order execution process for a specific wholesale trading operation. It must adhere to the specified schema to ensure all necessary parameters are provided correctly.

200.description: Successfully retrieved market order execution details.

GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the market order execution operations in the wholesale trading system.

GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Response_200.title: Market Order Execution Response

tradingBookId.description: The ID of the trading book associated with the order.

instrumentId.description: The ID of the financial instrument for which the order is placed.

side.description: The side of the order (e.g., buy or sell).

quantity.description: The quantity of the instrument to buy or sell.

limitPrice.description: The limit price for the order, if applicable.

orderType.description: The type of order (e.g., market, limit).

timeInForce.description: The time in force for the order (e.g., GTC, IOC).

venue.description: The trading venue where the order is executed.

recordStatus.description: The status of the order record (e.g., active, completed).

version.description: The version of the order record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the order record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the order execution response.
